preAuditSource.verdict: CURRENT LW BANK NEEDS GOLD REBUILD

identity.principle: Position-native left-corner curriculum. Not a mirrored Right Wing bank. Not Left Back content with a wing label.
mustTeach: positional width on the left sideline
left-side take-off geometry (toward middle / along six)
relationship with Left Back (timing, bind, pass lane)
relationship with pivot on the left half
when to ask for the ball
transition running lane from left wing
numerical situations that change the wing job
defensive responsibility as left-side wing defender
system-specific wing perception only when the system changes the cue
forbiddenFolklore: GK moves X = always shoot Y
mechanical L/R swap from Right Wing text
leftNativeGeometryNotes: Left corner, left sideline, six-metre arc approach from left
Primary backcourt partner is Left Back, not Right Back
Wing defender and half on the left create the local picture
Near post / far post must be reconstructed from LEFT wing angle
Take-off direction is a decision, not a decoration
Many elite LWs are right-handed; that changes execution more often than first tactical decision — tag handedness only when the decision itself changes

countRationale: 44 attack + 16 defence covers every required teaching family once, plus sparse system-specific extras that create a genuinely different LW cue.
Below CB/RW scale on purpose: quality and uniqueness over matching another position.
Above current 40 because the current bank is 11 clone families, not 40 teachings.
If a later pilot proves two families collapse into one, reduce; do not pad to 65.

attackDefenceSplit.note: Current bank is ~92/8 with one defensive idea. Target restores a real left-wing defensive curriculum without forcing defence parity.

difficultyTarget.rule: Difficulty = cognitive complexity of cues and interacting players. Minute/score never create Expert.

perceptionTarget.justification: Wing decisions are heavily cue-driven (hips, feet, GK hands/feet, recovery distance, pass lane, handover call). A healthy majority should be true perception scenarios. Remaining scenarios are principle/rule/risk cases (hold width, late-lead safety, some numerical possession rules) where ordinary game context is enough. Do not chase validator percentages; if a scenario has no observable cue that changes the decision, perception=false.

handednessStrategy.tagOnlyWhen: Throwing hand materially changes the FIRST tactical decision (not only finishing technique).
examplesWhereTagMayApply: Extreme-angle finish where strong-hand path is blocked and weak-hand / opposite-height decision is the tactical choice
Take-off geometry where throwing hand forces a different first step vs a covered near-post lane
examplesWhereTagMustNotApply: Ask for ball when hips open
GK near-foot commitment without a hand-dependent decision fork

separate.positionGeometry: Where to stand, when to move, who to read
separate.throwingHandExecution: How the shot/pass is executed after the decision

handednessStrategy.removeFromArchitecture: Artificial right-hand shade stickers from current scn_bank_080/091/102/083/094/105 lineage

answerQualityStandard.optimal: Best decision from the stated cues
answerQualityStandard.good: Reasonable conditional alternative whose condition is explicit or clearly implied
answerQualityStandard.poor: Clearly inferior; ignores the core picture
avoid: A and B both equally optimal
good secretly wrong without stated condition
answers differing only by style/timing wording
correct answer introducing unstated new information
unstated team rule required to prefer A over B — if a team rule is needed, state it in the situation

hr.require: Native-quality Croatian handball coaching language (ti-form preferred for direct coaching; consistent address)

languageRules.en: Actual coaching language; concrete geometry; no quiz prose
languageRules.de: Natural Handball terminology (Flügel, Kreisläufer, Abwehrhilfe, Absprung, Nah-/Ferneck) — not literal EN calques

mustDifferInAtLeastOne: goalkeeper behaviour that changes the fork
duplicateRiskFamiliesToWatch: stay_wide_because_help_inside vs stay_wide_because_lb_drives vs stay_wide_because_pass_lane — must keep distinct cues or merge
gk_near_commit vs gk_far_commit vs gk_late_hands — must not collapse into folklore shot maps
late_lead vs short_clock vs empty_own — risk must differ
transition_cover_own_lane vs far_skip — require teammate map uniqueness
backdoor vs entry_when — different cue and timing

existingBankDisposition.note: No existing ID is sacred. Preserve teaching ideas, not IDs. Phase 2 may allocate new IDs after locked banks.

Centred/deep GK + recovering defender race — rebuild with geometry

assumptionFlags.assumption: Force equal scenario counts across all defensive systems
assumptionFlags.strongerSolution: Sparse system matrix: include a system only when it creates a different LW perception problem than 6:0.
Target 60 from earned families; pad nothing.

assumptionFlags.assumption: Most LW scenarios need handedness tags because many LWs are right-handed
assumptionFlags.strongerSolution: Default none; tag 0–4 only when throwing hand changes the first decision.

assumptionFlags.assumption: Opponent empty goal is a required large LW cluster
assumptionFlags.strongerSolution: At most 1 scenario, only if the empty opponent goal uniquely changes the left-wing risk/finish decision.

assumptionFlags.assumption: Preserve current LW IDs to reduce migration cost
assumptionFlags.strongerSolution: Preserve teaching ideas; allocate clean IDs in Phase 2 without touching locked banks.

assumptionFlags.assumption: Mirror RW familyKeys with Left/Right substitution
assumptionFlags.strongerSolution: Reuse quality architecture (cue honesty, answer ladder, clone rules), write left-native families with LB as primary partner.

generationOrder: Pilot 10 left-native core scenarios (architecture families only; no bank write yet in Phase 1)
Lock LW gold only after human approval — still no deploy unless explicitly requested

requiredChecks: LB/RB/CB/RW counts and content hashes unchanged
no L/R mirrored RW titles or near-duplicate familyKeys
family uniqueness: one teaching objective per familyKey
semantic clone scan across score/minute variants
